info.title: AgentUtils API
info.description: Agent-facing and owner-facing HTTP API. One registry drives this document, llms.txt and the MCP tool surface.

post.summary: Pair a runtime with an agent using a pairing code.
post.description: Exchanges a one-time pairing code for a connection credential. Codes are single-use and expire 10 minutes after issue. The HTTP route enforces per-account rate limits; exceed them and the call fails with plan_limit_reached.

400.description: validation_failed: Some submitted values are invalid.

404.description: not_found: The requested resource was not found.

429.description: plan_limit_reached: Your plan limit has been reached.

503.description: temporarily_unavailable: The service is temporarily unavailable.

get.summary: Return the status of the calling connection.
get.description: Returns the connection record, the paired agent name, the account plan and the granted capabilities. Requires a valid connection credential (Bearer au_conn_…).

403.description: connection_revoked: This connection has been revoked. / permission_denied: You do not have permission to perform this action.

404.description: not_found: The requested resource was not found.

503.description: temporarily_unavailable: The service is temporarily unavailable.

post.summary: Create a secure credential handoff link.
post.description: Creates a handoff owned by the calling connection and returns its one-time view and submit tokens. The HTTP route applies connection rate limits.

400.description: validation_failed: Some submitted values are invalid.

403.description: permission_denied: You do not have permission to perform this action.

503.description: temporarily_unavailable: The service is temporarily unavailable.

post.summary: Decrypt values submitted to a handoff created by this connection.
post.description: Returns plaintext values only to the creating connection. Uses POST /v1/handoffs/decrypt with handoffId in the body so the shared registry has a single JSON input schema.

403.description: permission_denied: You do not have permission to perform this action.

404.description: not_found: The requested resource was not found.

410.description: resource_expired: This resource has expired. / resource_deleted: This resource has been deleted.

503.description: temporarily_unavailable: The service is temporarily unavailable.

post.summary: Close a handoff created by this connection.
post.description: Crypto-erases a handoff with the done reason. Owner revocation is intentionally owner-route-only and is never an MCP operation.

400.description: validation_failed: Some submitted values are invalid.

403.description: permission_denied: You do not have permission to perform this action.

404.description: not_found: The requested resource was not found.

410.description: resource_deleted: This resource has been deleted.

503.description: temporarily_unavailable: The service is temporarily unavailable.

post.summary: Return metadata-only status for an account handoff.
post.description: Any connection in the owning account may poll non-secret metadata. Uses POST /v1/handoffs/status with handoffId in the body; it never returns field values, tokens, or ciphertext metadata.
